title: The Bridge
text:
In a valley surrounded by mountains, two villages lived on (1) sides of a deep river. For generations, they had argued about water, land and (2) owned the fish. Children from one village were told never (3) to the children from the other.
One rainy season, the river rose so high that the old rope bridge (4) away. Both villages were cut off from the market town, and food began (5) run low. It was an old woman from the east village (6) first suggested building a new bridge together. Many people laughed at her. But she crossed the river by boat and spoke to the leaders of the west village. To everyone's surprise, they agreed.
For three months, men and women from both villages worked side by side. They learned each other's names first, (7) each other's stories. By the time the bridge (8) finished, the old arguments seemed small and silly. Today, the two villages hold a festival on the bridge every year, and the children, (9) grandparents once refused to speak to each other, play together (10) the middle.

items.stem: (1) In a valley surrounded by mountains, two villages lived on ___ sides of a deep river.
why_wrong: opposed = ไม่เห็นด้วย
oppose เป็นกริยา
opposition เป็นคำนาม
items.explanation_th: opposite sides = ฝั่งตรงข้าม (adjective)

items.stem: (2) For generations, they had argued about water, land and ___ owned the fish.
why_wrong: which ต้องมีคำนามให้ขยาย
whom ใช้ในตำแหน่งกรรม
what owned the fish = อะไรเป็นเจ้าของ ความหมายผิด
items.explanation_th: who owned the fish = ใครเป็นเจ้าของปลา (ประธาน)

items.stem: (3) Children from one village were told never ___ to the children from the other.
why_wrong: never talking ผิด
ขาด to
talked ผิด

items.stem: (4) One rainy season, the river rose so high that the old rope bridge ___ away.
why_wrong: washing ไม่ใช่กริยาแท้
has washed ผิด
was washing ผิด
items.explanation_th: สะพานถูกน้ำพัดไป → was washed away

items.stem: (5) Both villages were cut off from the market town, and food began ___ run low.
why_wrong: for run ผิด
by run ผิด
with run ผิด
items.explanation_th: begin to V → began to run low

items.stem: (6) It was an old woman from the east village ___ first suggested building a new bridge together.
why_wrong: which ใช้กับสิ่ง
whose ต้องตามด้วยคำนาม
where ใช้กับสถานที่
items.explanation_th: It was … who … (เน้นบุคคล)

items.stem: (7) They learned each other's names first, ___ each other's stories.
why_wrong: than ใช้เปรียบเทียบ
that ผิด
so ผิดความหมาย
items.explanation_th: first … then = ก่อน…แล้วจึง

items.stem: (8) By the time the bridge ___ finished, the old arguments seemed small and silly.
why_wrong: is เป็นปัจจุบัน
has been ไม่ใช้กับ By the time ในอดีต
will be เป็นอนาคต
items.explanation_th: By the time + อดีต passive → was finished

items.stem: (9) Today, the two villages hold a festival on the bridge every year, and the children, ___ grandparents once refused to speak to each other, play together … the middle.
why_wrong: who grandparents ผิด
which ใช้กับสิ่ง
that grandparents ผิด
items.explanation_th: ปู่ย่าของเด็ก ๆ → whose grandparents

items.stem: (10) Today, the two villages hold a festival on the bridge every year, and the children, … grandparents once refused to speak to each other, play together ___ the middle.
why_wrong: on the middle ผิด
at the middle ไม่ใช่สำนวนมาตรฐาน
by the middle ผิด
items.explanation_th: in the middle = ตรงกลาง
